# Wedding Seater

> Drag-and-drop wedding seating chart maker. Plan tables, handle family politics, and share one live link with everyone helping.

Wedding Seater is a web app for couples planning a wedding reception. You drag guests onto tables on a real floor plan, set rules for who can't sit near whom, and the planner works around them. The free demo is unlimited; £10 unlocks unlimited saved plans for life.
